business.name: Hotel Indigo New Orleans Garden District

ranking.name: Hotel Indigo New Orleans Garden District

text.text_excerpt: Fantastic hotel in the Garden District. I really enjoyed my stay in Hotel Indigo. The rooms were very affordable, beds comfortable, and the staff (especially Megan at the front desk) was very friendly and helpful. While it seemed a waste to have a meal in New Orleans in a hotel, the breakfast croissant and crepe were both divine, as was the coffee. The gym had the perfect amount of weights and machines for the size of the hotel, and I was also very impressed with the decor of the hotel and the rooms. Better for people not looking to spend their entire time in the French Quarter, as it is closer to Magazine street and uptown, although easily accessible by streetcar, bus, or cab.

Had a short, weekend stay here and everything was great. The front desk staff were super nice upon check-in and I had already prepaid for my room so it was just a matter of getting my room key. All about the details. This hotel has super nice finishes and unexpected touches that just bring a smile to my face. I know I've stayed in my fair share of cookie-cutter hotels where if you get off on the wrong floor, you can be circling for a few minutes before realizing you are on the wrong one. I feel like this hotel really customizes the details so you have a memorable stay. Stayed here for a week, while on business. The staff was always polite and very helpful. The room was clean, orderly, very modern. The bed was wonderfully comfortable. Their location was convenient for walking, driving, and using the trolley. Parking was annoying, as I had to park street-side, but that was the worst of my stay. If I can return here on vacation, I'll look into staying at the Indigo again.
